name: any
description: Arbitrarily chooses one record for each group in a summarize operator, and returns the value of one or more expressions over each such record.

name: anyif
description: Arbitrarily selects one record for each group in a summarize operator in records for which the predicate is 'true'.

name: argmax
description: Finds a row in the table that maximizes the specified expression.
note: Deprecated name of arg_max with older column naming (max_x, max_x_y); not accepted here. Use arg_max().

name: argmin
description: Finds a row in the table that minimizes the specified expression.
note: Deprecated name of arg_min; not accepted here. Use arg_min().

name: cnt
description: Counts the number of records per summarization group, or total if summarization is done without grouping.

name: count
description: Counts the number of records per summarization group, or total if summarization is done without grouping.

name: count_distinct
description: Counts unique values specified by the scalar expression per summary group, or the total number of unique values if the summary group is omitted.

name: count_distinctif
description: Conditionally counts unique values specified by the scalar expression per summary group, or the total number of unique values if the summary group is omitted.

name: countif
description: Counts the rows in which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: covariance
description: Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2.

name: covarianceif
description: Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2 in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: covariancep
description: Calculates the population covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2.

name: covariancepif
description: Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2 in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: dcount
description: Calculates an estimate of the number of distinct values that are taken by a scalar expression in the summary group.

name: dcountif
description: Estimates the number of distinct values of expr for rows in which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: make_bag
description: Creates a `dynamic` JSON property bag (dictionary) of all the values of expr in the group.

name: make_bag_if
description: Creates a `dynamic` JSON property bag (dictionary) of expr values in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: make_list
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of all the values of expr in the group.

name: make_list_if
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of expr values in the group for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: make_set
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in the group.

name: make_set_if
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: makelist
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of all the values of expr in the group.

name: makeset
description: Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in the group.

name: max
description: Finds the maximum value of the expression in the table.

name: maxif
description: Calculates the maximum value of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: merge_tdigest
description: Merges tdigest results across the group.

name: min
description: Finds the minimum value of the expression in the table.

name: minif
description: Returns the minimum of Expr in records for which Predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: percentilew
description: The `percentilew()` function calculates a weighted estimate for the specified nearest-rank percentile of the population defined by expr.

name: stdev
description: Calculates the standard deviation of expr across the group, using Bessel's correction for a small dataset that is considered a sample.

name: stdevif
description: Calculates the standard deviation of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: sum
description: Calculates the sum of expr across the group.

name: sumif
description: Calculates the sum of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: take_any
description: Arbitrarily chooses one record for each group in a summarize operator, and returns the value of one or more expressions over each such record.

name: take_anyif
description: Arbitrarily selects one record for each group in a summarize operator in records for which the predicate is 'true'.

name: variance
description: Calculates the variance of expr across the group, considering the group as a sample.

name: varianceif
description: Calculates the variance of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: variancep
description: Calculates the variance of expr across the group, considering the group as a population.

name: variancepif
description: Calculates the variance of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`.

name: binary_all_and
description: Returns aggregated value using the binary AND of the group.

name: binary_all_or
description: Returns aggregated value using the binary OR of the group.

name: binary_all_xor
description: Returns aggregated value using the binary XOR of the group.

name: buildschema
description: Returns the minimal schema that admits all values of the dynamic input.

name: make_list_with_nulls
description: Returns a list of all the values within the group, including null values.

name: arg_max
description: Returns one or more expressions when the argument is maximized.

name: arg_min
description: Returns one or more expressions when the argument is minimized.

name: avg
description: Returns an average value across the group.

name: avgif
description: Returns an average value across the group (with predicate).

name: hll
description: Returns the HyperLogLog (HLL) results of the group elements, an intermediate value of the `dcount` approximation.
note: The sketch encoding is gokql's own: dcount_hll and hll_merge agree within the estimate, but a sketch from ADX cannot be merged here.

name: hll_if
description: Returns the HyperLogLog (HLL) results of the group elements, an intermediate value of the `dcount` approximation (with predicate).

name: hll_merge
description: Returns a value for merged HLL results.

name: percentile
description: Returns a percentile estimation of the group.
note: Nearest-rank, as ADX: exact on small inputs; on large inputs ADX's t-digest can differ in the last digits.

name: percentiles
description: Returns percentile estimations of the group.
note: As percentile().

name: percentiles_array
description: Returns the percentile approximates of the array.

name: percentilesw
description: Returns the weighted percentile approximate of the group.

name: percentilesw_array
description: Returns the weighted percentile approximate of the array.

name: stdevp
description: Returns the standard deviation across the group for a population that is considered representative.

name: tdigest
description: Returns an intermediate result for the percentiles approximation, the weighted percentile approximate of the group.
note: The digest encoding is gokql's own; percentile_tdigest results agree within the digest's accuracy.

name: tdigest_merge
description: Returns the merged `tdigest` value across the group.

name: binary_and
description: Returns a result of the bitwise and operation between two values.

name: binary_not
description: Returns a bitwise negation of the input value.

name: binary_or
description: Returns a result of the bitwise or operation of the two values.

name: binary_shift_left
description: Returns binary shift left operation on a pair of numbers: a << n.

name: binary_shift_right
description: Returns binary shift right operation on a pair of numbers: a >> n.

name: binary_xor
description: Returns a result of the bitwise xor operation of the two values.

name: bitset_count_ones
description: Returns the number of set bits in the binary representation of a number.

name: case
description: Evaluates a list of predicates and returns the first result expression whose predicate is satisfied.

name: coalesce
description: Evaluates a list of expressions and returns the first non-null (or nonempty for string) expression.

name: iff
description: Evaluate the first argument (the predicate), and returns the value of either the second or third arguments, depending on whether the predicate evaluated to true (second) or false (third).

name: max_of
description: Returns the maximum value of several evaluated numeric expressions.

name: min_of
description: Returns the minimum value of several evaluated numeric expressions.

name: tobool
description: Convert inputs to boolean (signed 8-bit) representation.

name: todatetime

name: todecimal

name: toguid

name: toint

name: tolong

name: tostring

name: totimespan

name: datetime_diff

name: datetime_utc_to_local

name: dayofmonth

name: dayofweek

name: dayofyear

name: endofday

name: endofmonth

name: endofweek

name: endofyear

name: format_timespan

name: getyear

name: hourofday

name: make_datetime

name: make_timespan

name: monthofyear

name: now

name: startofday

name: startofmonth

name: startofweek

name: startofyear

name: array_index_of

name: GQL

name: all

name: any

name: labels

name: map

name: node_id

name: openCypher
